confirm.stop.message: It stops seeing and controlling this computer now. It can connect again unless you block it.

confirm.remove.message: Remove {name}? Its session ends. With the password it can connect again as a new computer.
confirm.signOut.title: Sign out?
confirm.signOut.message: Your own computers ask before connecting again, and the relay can't be set up again until you sign in. Computers already here keep their access.
settings.title: Settings
settings.themeHelp: Choose the visual theme for the application.
settings.languageHelp: Choose the language used throughout the application.
settings.realtimexNote: RealTimeX sets these to match its own settings when it starts and whenever you change them there.

settings.startWithComputerHelp: RealTimeX Link starts when this computer turns on, so computers you've allowed can connect even before anyone signs in. To get past the sign-in screen, they still need a Windows password.
settings.startWithComputerHelpMac: RealTimeX Link starts when this Mac turns on, so computers you've allowed can connect at the login window and lock screen. To log in, they still need a Mac password. After a restart with FileVault on, someone must unlock the Mac at the computer first.

settings.startWithComputerLoginItems: Nothing was changed. Allow RealTimeX Link in System Settings → General → Login Items, then try again.

confirm.startWithComputer.messageMac: Computers you've allowed will be able to see and use this Mac at the login window and lock screen. The same password and approvals apply. macOS asks for an administrator's password next.

confirm.turnOffLink.messageNoLogin: Published artifacts go offline, webhooks aren't received, the mobile app and other desktops can't reach this computer, and no one can connect for remote control.
